title: How AI can use health data to improve patient care
hook_text: Better patient care needs better data.
script:
The InSight+ report warns current healthcare data systems are failing to improve patient outcomes.
Poorly integrated data prevents clinicians from seeing the full picture of a patient's health journey.
AI can bridge these gaps by cleaning and standardizing fragmented information from hospital records.
This process helps clinicians move beyond simple chart reviews to identify actual patterns in patient health.
The goal is to shift from reactive care to proactive, data-informed medical decisions for every patient.
Would you prefer your doctor rely on AI-assisted data or traditional methods?
